method: Expanding-window seasonal walk-forward; each fold fits the feature Poisson model and estimates dispersion using training rows only. The benchmark is the pre-match league rolling mean. Poisson and NB2 probabilities are compared on identical held-out matches. Paired bootstrap CIs and sign-flip permutation tests are reported; Holm correction is applied across lines separately for Brier and Log Loss.
